description: Screenshot of the current frame as a PNG image. With `path`, also saves it to that file in the project. social: true letterboxes it into 1200×675 (16:9), the size X and Bluesky show for post images and link cards; save those under .debuff/captures/ and `debuff ship press` adds them to the press kit.

background.description: Letterbox colour with social, as CSS (default #000000).

path.description: Save the PNG here, relative to the project root (e.g. public/thumbnail.png). Overwrites.

social.description: Letterbox into 1200×675, scaled by whole pixels so pixel art stays crisp.

name: game_capture
title: Capture frame
